ink-black.$description: Ink Black — Primary text, borders, icon strokes — near-black carries all body and heading copy

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Dominant border color across the entire interface, card outlines, dividers

steel.$description: Steel — Secondary borders, muted icon fills, tertiary structural lines

pewter.$description: Pewter — Muted helper text, secondary link text, subdued metadata

ash.$description: Ash — Subtle background washes, low-contrast surface differentiation

canvas-white.$description: Canvas White — Card surfaces, image backgrounds, inverted text on dark regions

paper.$description: Paper — Page background — the dominant canvas tone behind all content

ember-orange.$description: Ember Orange — Supporting palette color for small decorative accents when the core palette needs contrast.

cobalt-drift.$description: Cobalt Drift — Gradient stop — blue-violet entry point in the tri-color brand gradient (blue → violet → orange) used for special accent surfaces

crimson-edge.$description: Crimson Edge — Gradient stop — deep red entry in the four-color brand gradient variant

teal-bridge.$description: Teal Bridge — Gradient stop — cool blue bridge into orange in the dual-tone gradient

arial.$description: Arial — detected in extracted data but not described by AI

sf-pro-display.$description: Sole typeface across the system — display headlines reach 100px at weight 400 with -3.1% tracking, subheadings at 53px weight 500 with -2% tracking, body at 15–17px weight 400. The choice to use weight 400–500 even at display sizes (rather than going bold) is signature: the type commands attention through scale and tightness, not weight. Substitute: Inter, or any geometric grotesque with strong x-height and tight default tracking.
